documentation.subject: A Phase 2 operation was refused because stored financial records do not reconcile
documentation.content:
## What this means

An operation was refused because the records it depends on do not reconcile: a stored figure is not what Constrap derives, a ledger is inconsistent or malformed, an invariant would not hold, or a stored record is not shaped as Constrap writes one. **Nothing was written.** It is not a user error and must be explained.

| Code | Usual cause |
|---|---|
| `variation-figures-inconsistent` | A submitted or approved variation whose lines or header do not reconcile (a legacy record, or a draft edited by an old tab on a half-cent line: DEPLOYMENT.md, Phase 2 step 2, known coexistence effect). Remedy: reject or withdraw and raise again. |
| `supplier-finance-ledger-inconsistent` | A ledger the baseline marked inconsistent (over-credit, several open claims on one PO, an entry naming no invoice), or a stored ledger figure not whole cents. Postings on it stay refused; only a corrective void is accepted. |
| `supplier-finance-figures-inconsistent` | A claim or invoice whose stored figures do not reconcile under its own calculation version. |
| `variation-unsupported-record`, `supplier-finance-unsupported-record` | Unknown calculation version, malformed lines or dates, or a counter that is not a whole number in range. |
| `client-ledger-invariant` | A client ledger is malformed, or a posting, receipt void, refund or application would breach an invariant. **Not alerted for `voidClientCreditNote` / `voidClientRetentionRelease`** (M1, 28 Nov 2026): there it is the approved Phase 1 refusal of a void that would breach an invariant (ADR-89 *Void policy*), an ordinary user outcome; it stays in the logs and in `phase2_refusals_by_code`. |
| `client-invoice-inconsistent`, `client-entry-invalid` | A client invoice or entry whose stored totals or shape do not reconcile. |
| `client-settlement-counter-invalid` | `counters/clientRefunds` or `counters/clientReceiptApplications` is not a whole number in range. |
| `estimate-inconsistent` | An estimate revision's stored chunks, totals or hash do not verify at approval. Remedy: rebuild. |

## Do this

1. Logs Explorer (read only): `resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="<service from the incident>" AND jsonPayload.message:"call refused" AND jsonPayload.code="<code>"` — note time, `fn`, `uid`.
2. Run `node ops/recovery/phase2-inventory.mjs --project constrapp-69b5d --company <companyId>` (read only); it names the documents and ledgers by id with the same codes.
3. Report to the Product Owner. Corrections go through the supported lifecycle (void, reject, withdraw, rebuild). Never edit a record, ledger or marker in the console; nothing is clamped or repaired by hand.

Never paste a log entry, an amount, a customer name or a token into a ticket or chat: give the service, the time, the project and document ids, and the code.

Runbook: `ops/monitoring/phase2/README.md`. Cutover and recovery: `docs/DEPLOYMENT.md`, section *Phase 2 — the complete cutover*.
